name: HH breakout 08 — channel break with ATR-multiple stop (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same Donchian/Turtle convexity (few breaks catch multi-week trends, ~5x payoff on ~33% wins) but on the DAILY clock and — the distinct upgrade — with an ATR-MULTIPLE stop (exit.atr_mult) instead of a fixed stop fraction, which is the actual Turtle risk rule: the stop distance scales with current volatility so a high-vol asset is given room and a low-vol asset is stopped tight, keeping the per-trade risk constant across regimes. Enter long on a range_position break to a new daily-scale high with adx above a trend floor. The daily clock captures the slowest, most-persistent trends and pays the fewest fees. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if it fails to beat buy-and-hold net of fees on the holdout, OR if the ATR-multiple stop does not outperform the fixed-fraction stop (the vol-normalization adds nothing → revert to fixed), OR if maxDD exceeds 25%, OR if removing the adx floor leaves the edge intact (the trend filter is decorative and the survivors are lucky tails).
catalyst: break to a new daily-scale high, risk sized by ATR
